svg.aria-label: The Analysis screen, on an animated phone, in six gestures. 1, choose the month: the left arrow goes from September back to August 2026, where spending rises to €1,412.36, then the right arrow returns to September and stops at the current month; the 1 month, 3 months and 1 year chips choose the period, which ends at the month shown: €4,118.63 over three months. 2, the tabs: Spending, €1,349.91; Income, €1,309.40, mostly the salary; Recurrences, €630.86 paid of €633.16 expected, with what is upcoming and what is paid. 3, the ring carries one icon per category, and its centre opens the month’s spending, day by day, with search and the Cash button. 4, further down, the list of categories: tapping Housing opens its total, -€556.77, 41% of the month’s spending, and its subcategories, Rent and Electricity, then as chips the ones with nothing this month. 5, tapping Rent opens its transactions day by day. 6, tapping Foncia Rent opens the transaction: name, movement, category Housing › Rent, type Essential, and Counts in September. At the bottom, the path Analysis, Housing, Rent, Foncia Rent is written as the pages open. Coming back, the analysis keeps the month, the period and the tab.

svg.text: THE ANALYSIS SCREEN
From the chosen month down to one transaction: every row opens, back goes up one level.

path.d: M9 3 H15 V9 H21 V15 H15 V21 H9 V15 H3 V9 H9 Z

svg.text: Choose the month
The arrows change the month; the right one stops at the current month.
1 month, 3 months or 1 year: the period ends at the month shown.
Spending, Income, Recurrences
Where the money goes, where it comes from, and what comes back every month.
Recurrences: paid, upcoming or late, against what was expected.
The centre of the ring
It opens the transactions the ring counts, day by day.
Around it, one icon per category, in the middle of its arc.
A category
Further down, the list of categories. Housing: its total, its share
of the month’s spending, and its subcategories, even empty ones.
A subcategory
Rent: its transactions over the period, day by day,
under the path Housing › Rent.
A transaction
Foncia Rent: its name, its movement, its category, its type,
and the month it counts in. Everything is fixed with one tap.
THE PATH
The analysis keeps the chosen month, period and tab: coming back, nothing has moved.
